top_signals.title: We Are Near Peak in 10-Year Yield: Roth
top_signals.summary: Stephanie Roth, chief economist at Wolfe Research joins Emily Graffeo on "Bloomberg Real Yield." US Treasuries rebounded from the global bond selloff that raced through European markets on Thursday. Earlier in the day, US 10-year yield surged to the highest level since 2002. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Mamdani Names NYC Districts for Affordable Housing Fast-Track
top_signals.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani identified a dozen parts of New York City where affordable housing projects will be eligible for a faster approval process, including Manhattan’s affluent Upper West Side and Upper East Side.
